notes.note: Scoped follow-up review of 6bdae93c65..82ac6b9843 for CLI cancellation. The report passes a shared AbortSignal to concurrent owned probes; SIGINT/SIGTERM abort their completion boundary, await maintained termination/settlement, remove listeners and exit 130/143 without partial JSON. Command deadlines, captures, failed/skipped status and existing platform/configuration/generated ownership claims remain unchanged. Desktop guide now documents this behavior; the other three guide journeys require no prose change. Real POSIX CLI signal keepers wait for three actual stalled process PIDs: baseline 6bdae and clean-commit signal-handler removal both fail process-absence assertions for SIGINT and SIGTERM; exact restored 82ac has 12PASS/3Windows-only skips. Prior Windows13/13 proof belongs to 844e40, not this new source. Hosted Node24.21 inner probe remains UNKNOWN; controlled serial-budget evidence is separate. No broad CI, native app/device or release qualification claim.
